id: \rI came to learn more about Fossils. Did you know most of the Pokémon that come from them are Rock- type?
en: \rI came to learn more about Fossils. Did you know most of the Pokémon that come from them are Rock- type?
it: \rSono venuta per saperne di più sui fossili. Lo sapevi che la maggior parte dei Pokémon che ne derivano è di tipo Roccia?

id: \bOh, hello. I'm a scientist.
en: \bOh, hello. I'm a scientist.
it: \bOh, ciao. Sono uno scienziato.

id: \bI can turn fossils into living, breathing Pokémon!
en: \bI can turn fossils into living, breathing Pokémon!
it: \bPosso trasformare i fossili in Pokémon vivi e vegeti!

id: \bAiyah! You come again!
en: \bAiyah! You come again!
it: \bAiyah! Tu tornato di nuovo!

id: \bDo you have a fossil for me?
en: \bDo you have a fossil for me?
it: \bHai un fossile per me?

id: \bWhich fossil do you want me to revive?
en: \bWhich fossil do you want me to revive?
it: \bQuale fossile vuoi che rianimi?

id: \bLet me know when you want me to revive a fossil for you.
en: \bLet me know when you want me to revive a fossil for you.
it: \bFammi sapere quando vuoi che ti rigeneri un fossile.

id: \bOkay. I'll see if I can revive your \v[3].
en: \bOkay. I'll see if I can revive your \v[3].
it: \bD'accordo. Vedrò se riesco a rigenerare il tuo \v[3].

id: \bCome back later.
en: \bCome back later.
it: \bTorna più tardi.

id: \bI'll be here if you want my help.
en: \bI'll be here if you want my help.
it: \bSono qui se ti serve il mio aiuto.

id: \bWhere have you been? I've finished reviving your fossil.
en: \bWhere have you been? I've finished reviving your fossil.
it: \bDove ti eri cacciato? Ho finito di rianimare il tuo fossile.

id: \bIt was \v[3] like I thought.
en: \bIt was \v[3] like I thought.
it: \bEra un \v[3], proprio come pensavo.

id: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
it: \bNon hai più spazio. Fai spazio, poi torna da me.

id: \bI managed to revive your fossil.
en: \bI managed to revive your fossil.
it: \bSono riuscito a rigenerare il tuo fossile.

id: \bHowever, what I brought back didn't live long...\1 fortunately.
en: \bHowever, what I brought back didn't live long...\1 fortunately.
it: \bPerò, quello che ho riportato in vita non è vissuto a lungo...\1 per fortuna.

id: \bSorry.
en: \bSorry.
it: \bMi dispiace.

id: \bI told you, come back later.
en: \bI told you, come back later.
it: \bTe l'ho detto, torna più tardi.

id: \bFossils are amazing. To think, we can bring back Pokémon from ancient times.
en: \bFossils are amazing. To think, we can bring back Pokémon from ancient times.
it: \bI fossili sono incredibili. Pensa, possiamo riportare in vita Pokémon dei tempi antichi.

en: Yes
